title: The Erdos Minimum-Overlap Constant Exceeds 0.38055925
description: A new center certificate, checked by separately implemented Arb and MPFI verifiers, combines with a replay of Price's original checker on 170 noncentral bins to establish c_E > 0.38055925. This paper-inclusive archival patch adds an explicitly named compiled PDF, deterministic paper-source archive, and SHA-256 manifest. The theorem, proof, certificates, data, and computations are unchanged from v0.3.0.
